title: Broken Crown Loop
style: Drift phonk with half-time intro and a double-time switch into a grimy Memphis bounce at 140 BPM; verse rides sparse and tense, pre-chorus tightens with clipped chants, chorus opens into an emotional melodic hook. Male whisper lead stays close-mic and menacing, female ethereal echoes trail the hook word. Tape hiss, chopped cowbell stabs, reversed swells, and sudden dropouts shape the transitions. Lo-fi, distorted, and addictive with a viral heartbreak aftertaste., lo-fi, emotional, latin
lyrics:
[Intro]
I seen your name in the smoke
It still burns on my tongue
(rise)
I drove too fast for the night
Now the night got me
(ay)

[Verse 1]
Rafa in the dash lane
Hands on the wheel, no sleep
Your last text cut deep
Like glass in a backseat
Cold grin, red eyes
I been wide on the edge
Heart doin' laps in a cage
While the miles never end
You said, "Don't call me again"
I said, "I won't, I won't"
But my chest keep replaying
Every word you threw and gone

[Pre-Chorus]
Now I hear that echo
In the parking lot rain
Took your love like a blade
Left my name in the stain
I spin it back, I spin it back
Till the hurt turns sweet
One more turn, one more crash
And you come for me

[Chorus]
Broken crown, broken crown
I'm still spinning now
Broken crown, broken crown
You tear me down
Hold me close, then let me drown
(hold me close)
Broken crown, broken crown
I'm still spinning now

[Verse 2]
Dark club, low floor
Shoes scrape on the floorboards
Your shadow in the corner
Got me begging for more
I laugh with my teeth clenched
You talk like you won
But I know that your ghost
Still comes when I'm gone
Rafa on the corner
With the lights cut low
I been turning this hurt
Till it starts to glow
You say I move like a curse
I say maybe I do
If heartbreak was a city
I would ride it for you

[Pre-Chorus]
Now I hear that echo
In the parking lot rain
Took your love like a blade
Left my name in the stain
I spin it back, I spin it back
Till the hurt turns sweet
One more turn, one more crash
And you come for me

[Chorus]
Broken crown, broken crown
I'm still spinning now
Broken crown, broken crown
You tear me down
Hold me close, then let me drown
(hold me close)
Broken crown, broken crown
I'm still spinning now

[Bridge]
[F]
I float through the ruin
Like a pale, lost thread
[M]
I keep your shadow
Under my bed
[F]
Say my name like pardon
Say my name like sin
[M]
If I lose this feeling
Let me fall back in
(ah)
(come back)
(come back)

[Chorus]
Broken crown, broken crown
I'm still spinning now
Broken crown, broken crown
You tear me down
Hold me close, then let me drown
(hold me close)
Broken crown, broken crown
I'm still spinning now
